about: The climate domain's truth mappings for claims about heating, cooling, fans, vents, filters and the air (kernel/speech.py truth(); VERIFY_HARDENING 13.1-13.3, 13.6; WP-D climate). Words from house_sim/data/vocab/climate.json and the core vocabulary. Conditions read the subject's own record (hidden truth included: the evaluator's view, never an observation). states (the first condition whose field the record has decides): heating is a central system in its heat or aux stage, a thermostat or mini-split calling for heat, a radiator with its heat on; cooling is a central system in its cool stage, a thermostat or mini-split calling for cooling or drying; spinning is a ceiling fan's blades turning or a portable fan running. issues (any condition present and holding makes it true, all present and failing make it false, none present leaves it unknown): a blocked vent is a vent whose blocked flag holds (or whose issues list it); a closed vent a damper shut or part shut; a dirty filter one visibly dusty (the 35 % its look shows) or a purifier asking for a new one; a wrapped filter one still in its plastic; a reversed filter one fitted the wrong way round; short cycling more than four starts in the last hour; a frozen coil the system's fault; condensation a pane fogged past 30 % (what a look calls fogged); stuffy, too humid, too dry and drafty read the air fields of a room at the thresholds of the robot's feel cues (a hygrometer's digits for humid and dry): the kernel judges a room's issue over its things, so a room subject stays unscored until it reads the room's own record (handoff_WP-D_climate.md, request to WP4). acts: set is any control verb on the thing (lenient: known only by its actions), fill a reservoir or vessel filled by this domain's or plumbing's verbs (lenient). The kernel's own words (on, off, running, open, closed, turn_on, turn_off, jammed for 'blocked') are truth.json's; hot, cold and warm are left unscored (no threshold fits every thing and listener), like the cleaning-owned dirty and full.
